errors.baseline_requirement: Ground staff shall view a flight's assigned gate on the operations board.
errors.message: Show an estimated boarding-start time next to the gate on that board.
errors.model_reasoning: Adding a new display field (boarding-start time) to an existing operations board view.

errors.baseline_requirement: Pickers shall confirm each picked item by scanning its barcode.
errors.message: Keep barcode confirmation, but let a picker attach an optional spoken note when a shelf is damaged.
errors.model_reasoning: Adding a new optional step (spoken note) to an existing mandatory process (barcode scan).

errors.baseline_requirement: Inspectors shall attach photographs and notes to every failed vehicle inspection.
errors.message: Stop collecting the photographs; retain the written notes.
errors.model_reasoning: The data collection requirement is changed from 'photographs and notes' to 'notes' only.

errors.baseline_requirement: Applicants shall receive both email and SMS when an award decision is issued.
errors.message: We no longer want the text message; send only the email.
errors.model_reasoning: The channel of communication (SMS) is being removed.

errors.baseline_requirement: Students shall open course notes in the browser or download them as PDF.
errors.message: Disable PDF downloads of notes while keeping browser access.
errors.model_reasoning: The channel for accessing course notes is being restricted.

errors.baseline_requirement: The public forecast shall display wind speed and relative humidity.
errors.message: Hide relative humidity from the public forecast, but retain wind speed.
errors.model_reasoning: Modifying visibility rules for existing data items.

errors.baseline_requirement: Donors may choose a one-time or monthly contribution.
errors.message: The donation form should offer monthly contributions only.
errors.model_reasoning: Changing the default option from 'one-time or monthly' to 'monthly' is a modification.

errors.baseline_requirement: Dispensing alerts shall appear on the dashboard and be emailed to the pharmacist.
errors.message: Stop the email copy of dispensing alerts; the dashboard alert remains.
errors.model_reasoning: The baseline requirement specifies that both the dashboard and email are part of the alert delivery process. The new message removes the email component while retaining the dashboard alert.

errors.baseline_requirement: Students may enroll through the online portal or a campus kiosk.
errors.message: Close kiosk enrollment after term ends; online enrollment remains.
errors.model_reasoning: The kiosk enrollment option is removed, while online enrollment remains.

errors.baseline_requirement: Students shall see final grades only after the registrar publishes them.
errors.message: We need to revisit when students can see marks, but faculty disagree about timing.
errors.model_reasoning: The baseline defines a clear timing rule (after registrar publishes). The new message indicates a need to revisit this timing, which is a modification.

errors.baseline_requirement: Visitors shall search issued permits by street address.
errors.message: Please add a fee estimator for permit applicants.
errors.model_reasoning: A new capability (fee estimator) is requested while the baseline search-by-address requirement remains.

errors.baseline_requirement: Baggage handlers shall see the last scan location of each checked bag.
errors.message: Give passengers a seat-map preview before check-in.
errors.model_reasoning: A new capability (seat-map preview) is introduced for passengers while the baseline baggage tracking remains.

errors.baseline_requirement: Managers shall download a monthly summary of discharge counts.
errors.message: Let patients preselect a meal from the ward menu.
errors.model_reasoning: A new capability (patient meal selection) is introduced while the baseline discharge summary download remains.

errors.baseline_requirement: Door staff shall scan a visitor's QR ticket to admit them.
errors.message: Add Spanish narration to the audio guide.
errors.model_reasoning: Adding a new language option (Spanish) to an existing audio guide is a new capability.

errors.baseline_requirement: The public map shall display the next bus arrival time for each stop.
errors.message: Change the wording on emailed fare receipts.
errors.model_reasoning: Modifying the wording of an email template is a change to the presentation of existing data.

errors.baseline_requirement: Students shall book available study rooms through the campus portal.
errors.message: Show lecture timetable colours in the student portal.
errors.model_reasoning: A new visualization feature (timetable colours) is being requested for an existing portal.

errors.baseline_requirement: Claimants shall download a PDF copy of their submitted claim.
errors.message: Add a camera shortcut for taking claim photos.
errors.model_reasoning: A new capture method (camera) is introduced to supplement the existing PDF download requirement.
